specific_objectives: 25.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy and introduce about IN aircrafts, its roles and operating squadrons/ flights.

intro_questions: What is the primary role of the Indian Navy Air Arm?
Name one major naval air base in India.
Can you recall the designation of the Navy's fighter squadron?

development.content:
Introduction to Naval Air Squadrons
Types of Aircraft Operating
Roles of Naval Aviation
Locations of Key Squadrons

Operational Roles of Squadrons
Aircraft Capabilities Overview
Strategic Locations Analysis
Squadron Emblems and History

Future Aircraft Integration
Maintenance Support Roles
Logistics and Supply Chain
Training and Readiness Standards

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a flight and a squadron in naval aviation.
Identify the primary role of the Sea Harrier squadron.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the location and role of the Naval Air Enclave for the next lesson plan.
